items.q: He don't play. He's not in the music field, Bill Beeson.

ctx.x: Dicky Wells, Charles Blumer, and the drummer, I'm trying to think of his name, but he was so good. He's still in New York. He don't play. He's not in the music field, Bill Beeson.
